title: Morita equivalence for $L^p$-operator algebras associated with étale groupoids
summary: We prove that equivalent locally compact, locally Hausdorff, étale groupoids with paracompact unit spaces have Morita equivalent reduced and full $L^p$-operator algebras for every $p\in[1,\infty]$. The reduced theorem requires pairing-valued approximate identities, reflecting the failure of unconditionality of the reduced norm for $1<p<\infty$, while the full theorem rests on a full-clopen reduction theorem proved by dilating spatial representations.
